offering_description.value: Flotek formulates and supplies specialty chemicals for oil and gas operators and oilfield service companies. It also provides optical analyzers and real-time fluid composition data to companies that produce, transport or process hydrocarbons.

primary_products.value: Hydraulic fracturing additives; oilfield production chemicals; hydrocarbon composition analyzers

primary_services.value: Oilfield chemical formulation and testing; real-time hydrocarbon measurement and analytics

customer_segment.value: B2B: Oil and gas producers, pressure pumping companies, pipeline operators and hydrocarbon processors

end_markets.value: Oil and gas well completion; oil and gas production; hydrocarbon transportation and processing; refining

revenue_model.value: product sales: Specialty oilfield chemicals and hydrocarbon analyzers; project or contract: Chemical supply agreements with oilfield service companies; service fees: Hydrocarbon measurement and analytics services
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Formulates and blends chemical ingredients for producers and pressure pumpers and builds optical analyzers for energy operators; service provider: Tests oilfield fluids and analyzes hydrocarbon streams for energy operators

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with international oilfield markets including the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: Oilfield chemistry and real-time hydrocarbon measurement

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Commercial and technical sales teams serving energy operators and oilfield service companies; partners / resellers: Pressure pumping companies that deliver completion chemicals on well sites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Chemical blending, handling and shipment subject to EPA environmental rules, OSHA safety standards and DOT hazardous materials rules

notes: The current international footprint and the mix of analyzer sales, rentals and service contracts are uncertain.
